_doc: Capital Markets chart brand config — Briggs Brand Standards v3 / Northmarq 2024 guide. Single source of truth for CM chart typography, palette, series-ramp order, and color proportions. Loaded by api/_shared/cm-native-chart-injector.js (CM_BRAND). Per-vertical overrides live under `verticals`. This is DATA, not code — a future brand-guide update is a JSON change, not a code change.

_source._provenance_note: The three authoritative source files live in Scott's OneDrive (_WORKFLOW folder) and were NOT reachable from the build sandbox. Values below are taken from Scott's A1-v2 token spec (stated as derived from Briggs v3) and cross-checked against public/reports/cm_brand_tokens.json (reverse-engineered from the gov master workbook theme). ACTION: diff these hexes against the 2024 PDF data-styling page + colorproportions.png and correct any delta here — the PDF + Briggs v3 win. Log deltas in this block.

_typeface_note: Open Sans is the Excel-safe default that renders on every machine. Flip `typeface` to Futura PT ONLY once it is confirmed installed on every machine that opens these workbooks, else Excel silently falls back to the theme font.
_series_ramp_note: Per colorproportions.png: primary blues dominate; tertiary hues (peridot/amethyst/topaz/aquamarine/tourmaline) are series 4+ and should occupy <10% of any chart. Use slot N for series N.
_banned_note: Retired off-brand accents/grays. Slate #6A748C is intentionally NOT banned (it is the on-brand axis/legend neutral).
